correctness.rationale: Helper implements the documented exit/result contract: env defaults (INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT), allow-list load with API_ERROR on failure, head SHA before/after snapshot with SHA_CHANGED exit 3, CONVERGED when unresolved allow-listed bot threads are zero and every participating bot has a review on the current head, QUIET_ELAPSED from latest actionable timestamps, TIMEOUT at MAX_WAIT, and RESULT=/HEAD= stdout lines. Bats fixtures affirm normalization, converged gating, stale-head review rejection, and quiet-window math. Minor residual gaps: convergence treats any on-head review as terminal without checking review state (e.g. PENDING), and GraphQL uses reviews(last:100) which could miss older head reviews on very active PRs.

quality.rationale: Implementation is readable and repo-aligned: shell entrypoint with clear header contract, paginated GraphQL fetcher, extracted snapshot_logic testable via awk (matching existing shell-test patterns), canonical bot-allowlist.txt, and companion updates to pr-resolve-all.md (preferred helper plus preserved time-based fallback), AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, and scripts/README.md. Deductions for runtime-generated embedded Python helpers (509-line script, duplicated normalize_bot_login in bash and python) and breadth of the change set versus a minimal helper-only patch.

process.rationale: Diff stays on-task across eight files (helper, allow-list, bats, smoke check, scripts inventory, required prompt/docs) with no forbidden live-state surfaces, no PLAN.md/AGENTS.md churn, explicit pre-#321 scope boundary, and documented fallback retained. Doc-sync discipline is evident. One point withheld because the bundle contains no verification transcript or run log beyond objective automation skips.

reliability.rationale: Verification wiring is substantive: pr-resolve-all-poll.bats exercises snapshot_logic fixtures (converged, unresolved bot threads, human-thread exclusion, stale reviews, quiet elapsed/not elapsed, --help, missing allow-list API_ERROR), 141-pr-resolve-all-poll-smoke.sh runs bats plus grep assertions on prompt fallback/SHA_CHANGED docs, and 105-scripts.sh inventories new artifacts. Objective evidence shows bats_poll_helper skipped in bundle-only grading, so pass/fail of the full bats suite is not confirmed here; no integration tests cover live poll-loop SHA_CHANGED/TIMEOUT paths.
